text: Recite what has been revealed to you of this Quran, and act upon it, and perform the salah with its limits, for maintaining the salah prevents its performer from falling into sins and evil deeds; That is because the one who establishes it, completing its pillars and conditions, his heart is illuminated, his faith increases, his desire for good grows stronger, and his desire for evil diminishes or ceases, and the remembrance of Allah in the salah and elsewhere is greater, larger, and better than everything. And Allah knows what you do of good and evil, and He will recompense you for that with the most complete and fullest recompense.
